svg.title: Octo Ramen — Eight arms. One perfect bowl.
svg.desc: A joyful coral octopus in a chef's hat cooks at a lantern-lit Japanese ramen booth. Eight curling, sucker-lined arms juggle a ladle, a bowl, scallions, a knife, a spice shaker, chopsticks, tea, and an egg. Golden noodles fall into a beautifully garnished bowl. An illustrated midnight-market poster in indigo, cream, vermilion, and gold.
svg.text: A LITTLE BOOTH. A LOT OF SOUL.
FRESH NOODLES / DEEP BROTH / LATE NIGHTS
